comment: Leaders (GDD 7.5; stage 4f PR 2). Every civilization has a leader with a name from its people's language, an age and traitCount traits. While a leader rules, each trait adds its shifts (per mille) to the civilization's character (aggression, expansiveness, tradefulness, curiosity, openness, caution, vengefulness, loyalty), so a new ruler changes the policy at once (Patryk's decision 2026-11-07: each trait shifts 1-2 character traits by 0.2). Leaders age and may die every year: deathByAge gives the chance per year (per mille) at an age, linear between the points. startAge: age of the first leaders. councilCandidates: how many candidates a council weighs. Who comes next and whether there is a crisis is set by the government (governments.json).
